name: Yearly County-Level Denominator Covariates
description: Yearly County-level denominator covariates: rates and percentages describing the Medicaid population in each area (e.g., percent female, percent dual-eligible, percent fee-for-service, age and race distributions), by cohort. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only).
